**Standards — FAIL (one material gap). Spec — FAIL (same finding).**

`tools/isswf-job.mjs:73-77` classifies nonlocal sources only via `/^(?:npm:|git:|https?:|ssh:)/`, otherwise resolves `.pi`-relative. Pi itself treats `file:` URLs as local and converts them to the real path (`.../dist/utils/paths.js:35-45,71-79`; `parseSource` local branch), so a hand-written `file:///…/isswf-pi-resources` second declaration is loaded by Pi but resolves here to `<project>/.pi/file:…` → ENOENT → `continue` (:80) → never counted. With the pinned absolute entry present, `matches.length===1` (:83) passes. Same ambiguity class as v1 finding 1, narrowed, not closed; contradicts v2 docs `local-worker-lifecycle.md:31` ("Exactly one local isSWF package declaration must exist").

Everything else holds. Payload hashes match manifest and worktree; `candidate.diff` equals tracked `git diff` (dfe8c6ca…); `pi-worker-task`/`worker-lifecycle` blobs match offline-v5 `productionHashes`. Both prior findings fixed: relatives counted (:77-81), nonlocal named factory refused (:74-75), write-once sibling binding written before launch (:109-125), `read`/`reconcile` correlate binding↔dispatch pins/hashes (:131-137). offline-v5 PASS (11 negatives) proves real exit-9 after binding write, pre-dispatch → `unknown` + repeat blocked; dot-prefixed overlap guard tested (:106-110). Non-blocking: bare `~` unresolved; v1 minors unchanged.

Read-only; no mutation, Python, provider, or network.
